json-formatter.name: Formattatore JSON
json-formatter.description: Formatta, valida e abbellisci i dati JSON con evidenziazione della sintassi
json-formatter.pageDescription: Formatta, abbellisci, comprimi e valida dati JSON online. Supporta il controllo della sintassi e l'indentazione personalizzata.
json-formatter.seoContent: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) è un formato leggero per lo scambio di dati. Questo strumento di formattazione JSON ti aiuta a formattare, abbellire, comprimere e validare i dati JSON. Basta incollare il tuo JSON, cliccare su Formatta e ottenere un output pulito e leggibile. Perfetto per il debug di risposte API, file di configurazione ed elaborazione dati.
json-formatter.seoFeature1: Formattazione e abbellimento JSON con indentazione personalizzata (2, 4 o 8 spazi)
json-formatter.seoFeature2: Compressione JSON per uso in produzione
json-formatter.seoFeature3: Validazione della sintassi JSON con messaggi di errore dettagliati
json-formatter.seoFeature4: Elaborazione 100% lato client — i tuoi dati non lasciano mai il browser

faqs.a: JSON formatting is the process of adding proper indentation, line breaks, and spacing to JSON data to make it more readable. It doesn't change the data itself, just its visual presentation.

faqs.q: Is this JSON formatter safe to use?
faqs.a: Yes, 100% safe. All processing happens directly in your browser. Your JSON data is never sent to any server or stored anywhere.

faqs.q: Can I validate JSON with this tool?
faqs.a: Yes. Click the Validate button to check if your JSON is syntactically correct. The tool will show detailed error messages if any issues are found.

howToUseSteps: Paste your JSON data into the input field on the left
Choose your preferred indentation (2, 4, or 8 spaces)
Click 'Format / Beautify' for readable output, or 'Minify' for compact output
Copy the result using the copy button

base64.name: Codificatore/Decodificatore Base64
base64.description: Codifica testo in Base64 o decodifica Base64 in testo
base64.pageDescription: Codifica testo in Base64 o decodifica stringhe Base64 in testo semplice. Supporta UTF-8.
base64.decodePlaceholder: Inserisci la stringa Base64 da decodificare...
base64.seoContent: Base64 è uno schema di codifica da binario a testo che rappresenta i dati binari in formato stringa ASCII. È comunemente usato per codificare dati in URL, email, HTML e API. Questo strumento supporta la codifica e decodifica completa UTF-8.

faqs.a: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that converts binary data into ASCII characters. It's commonly used to transmit data safely over text-based protocols like HTTP and email.

faqs.q: Is Base64 encoding the same as encryption?
faqs.a: No. Base64 is an encoding scheme, not encryption. Anyone can decode Base64 data. It's meant for data transport, not security.
Yes. This tool fully supports UTF-8 encoding and decoding, allowing you to work with international characters and emojis.

howToUseSteps: Enter your plain text in the top field to encode, or Base64 string in the bottom field to decode
Click 'Encode' to convert text to Base64, or 'Decode' to convert Base64 back to text
Copy the result with the copy button
useCases: Encoding images for embedding in HTML/CSS
Transmitting binary data in JSON APIs

url-encoder.name: Codificatore/Decodificatore URL
url-encoder.description: Codifica o decodifica componenti URL e parametri di query
url-encoder.pageDescription: Codifica o decodifica URL e componenti URI. Supporta encodeURIComponent e encodeURI.
url-encoder.seoContent: La codifica URL sostituisce i caratteri ASCII non sicuri con un "%" seguito da due cifre esadecimali. È essenziale per passare caratteri speciali in URL, parametri di query e dati dei form. Usa encodeURIComponent per i parametri di query e encodeURI per gli URL completi.

faqs.a: URL encoding replaces unsafe ASCII characters with a '%' followed by two hex digits. This ensures special characters are safely transmitted in URLs.

faqs.q: What's the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?
faqs.a: encodeURI encodes a full URL but preserves characters like :, /, ?, &. encodeURIComponent encodes everything including those characters, making it suitable for query parameter values.
Always URL encode when passing user input as query parameters, form data, or any URL component that may contain special characters like spaces, &, =, or #.

howToUseSteps: Enter text in the input field
Choose between URI Component or Full URI encoding mode
Click 'Encode' or 'Decode'
Copy the result
useCases: Handling special characters in API requests

hash-generator.name: Generatore di hash
hash-generator.description: Genera hash MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 da testo
hash-generator.pageDescription: Genera hash SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 da qualsiasi testo. Tutto calcolato nel tuo browser.
hash-generator.seoContent: Le funzioni hash crittografiche generano un valore hash di dimensione fissa a partire dai dati in ingresso. Vengono utilizzate per la verifica dell'integrità dei dati, l'archiviazione delle password, le firme digitali e altro ancora. SHA-256 è l'algoritmo più comunemente usato oggi.

faqs.a: A hash function takes input data and produces a fixed-size string of characters (hash). The same input always produces the same hash, but you cannot reverse a hash back to the original data.

faqs.q: Which hash algorithm should I use?
faqs.a: SHA-256 is recommended for most purposes. SHA-512 offers more security. MD5 and SHA-1 are considered weak for security but are still used for checksums.
Yes. All hash computation happens in your browser using the Web Crypto API. No data is sent to any server.

howToUseSteps: Enter or paste your text in the input field
Click 'Generate Hashes' to compute all hash values
Toggle 'Uppercase' for uppercase hex output
Copy any hash value with the copy button

uuid-generator.name: Generatore UUID
uuid-generator.description: Genera UUID casuali (v4) in blocco con un clic
uuid-generator.pageDescription: Genera UUID casuali (v4) in blocco. Supporta formati maiuscoli e senza trattini.
uuid-generator.emptyState: Clicca "Genera UUID" per creare UUID casuali
uuid-generator.seoContent: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) v4 genera identificatori casuali a 128 bit. Con 122 bit casuali, la probabilità di una collisione è astronomicamente bassa. Gli UUID sono comunemente usati come chiavi primarie nei database, token di sessione e identificatori nei sistemi distribuiti.

faqs.a: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information. Version 4 UUIDs are randomly generated, making collision probability astronomically low.
While not mathematically guaranteed, UUID v4 has 2^122 possible values. The probability of generating a duplicate is essentially zero for practical purposes.
Use UUIDs as database primary keys, API resource identifiers, session tokens, or any time you need a unique identifier without a central authority.

howToUseSteps: Set the number of UUIDs to generate (1-20)
Choose options: uppercase, no dashes
Click 'Generate UUIDs'
Click on any UUID to copy, or use 'Copy All'

timestamp-converter.name: Convertitore timestamp Unix
timestamp-converter.description: Converti tra timestamp Unix e date leggibili
timestamp-converter.pageDescription: Converti timestamp Unix in date leggibili e viceversa. Rileva automaticamente secondi e millisecondi.
timestamp-converter.seoContent: Un timestamp Unix rappresenta il numero di secondi trascorsi dal 1° gennaio 1970 (UTC). È ampiamente utilizzato nella programmazione, nei database e nelle API. Questo strumento rileva automaticamente se l'input è in secondi o millisecondi.

faqs.a: A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC (the Unix epoch). It's a universal way to represent time in computing.

faqs.q: What's the difference between seconds and milliseconds?
faqs.a: Unix timestamps in seconds are 10 digits (e.g., 1700000000), while milliseconds are 13 digits (e.g., 1700000000000). JavaScript uses milliseconds, most systems use seconds.
Yes. The tool shows both UTC and your local timezone when converting timestamps, so you can see the exact time in both.

howToUseSteps: Enter a Unix timestamp to convert to a human-readable date
Or enter a date string to convert to a Unix timestamp
The tool auto-detects seconds vs milliseconds
View results in UTC, local time, and ISO format
useCases: Converting API timestamps to readable dates
Working with JWT token expiration times

color-converter.name: Convertitore di colori
color-converter.description: Converti colori tra formati HEX, RGB, HSL con anteprima
color-converter.pageDescription: Converti colori tra formati HEX, RGB e HSL con anteprima dal vivo.
color-converter.emptyState: Inserisci un valore di colore e clicca Converti
color-converter.seoContent: I colori HEX usano la notazione esadecimale (#RRGGBB). RGB usa i canali rosso, verde e blu (0-255). HSL usa tonalità (0-360°), saturazione (0-100%) e luminosità (0-100%). Ogni formato ha i suoi utilizzi nel web design, CSS e grafica.

faqs.a: This tool supports HEX (e.g., #FF5733), RGB (e.g., rgb(255,87,51)), and HSL (e.g., hsl(11,100%,60%)) formats.

faqs.q: What's the difference between HEX, RGB, and HSL?
faqs.a: HEX uses hexadecimal notation. RGB defines colors by red, green, blue values (0-255). HSL uses hue (0-360), saturation, and lightness percentages.

faqs.q: Can I use the color picker?
faqs.a: Yes. Use the built-in color picker to visually select a color, and all format values will update automatically.

howToUseSteps: Enter a color value in any format (HEX, RGB, or HSL)
All other formats update automatically in real-time
Use the color picker for visual selection
Copy any color format with the copy button
useCases: Finding HEX values for CSS styling
Adjusting colors with HSL for hue/saturation tweaks

regex-tester.name: Tester Regex
regex-tester.description: Testa espressioni regolari con corrispondenza ed evidenziazione in tempo reale
regex-tester.pageDescription: Testa espressioni regolari con corrispondenza in tempo reale, evidenziazione e supporto per gruppi di cattura.
regex-tester.testPlaceholder: Inserisci la tua stringa di test qui...
regex-tester.seoContent: Le espressioni regolari (regex) sono potenti pattern utilizzati per la corrispondenza, la ricerca e la sostituzione di testo. Sono essenziali per la validazione dell'input, l'elaborazione del testo e l'estrazione di dati. Questo strumento testa le tue regex in tempo reale con il motore regex di JavaScript.

faqs.a: A regular expression (regex) is a pattern used to match, search, and manipulate text. It's supported in virtually every programming language.

faqs.q: How do I test my regex?
faqs.a: Enter your regex pattern in the pattern field, add test text below, and the tool will highlight all matches in real-time. Flags like 'g' (global) and 'i' (case-insensitive) are supported.
Yes. All regex processing happens in your browser using JavaScript's built-in RegExp engine. No data is sent anywhere.

howToUseSteps: Enter your regex pattern in the pattern field
Add flags (g for global, i for case-insensitive, m for multiline)
Type or paste your test text
View highlighted matches and match details in real-time
useCases: Validating email addresses, URLs, or phone numbers
Extracting data from text (log parsing, web scraping)

markdown-preview.name: Anteprima Markdown
markdown-preview.description: Scrivi Markdown e visualizza l'anteprima renderizzata fianco a fianco
markdown-preview.pageDescription: Scrivi Markdown e visualizza l'anteprima HTML renderizzata in tempo reale. Editor e anteprima affiancati.
markdown-preview.seoContent: Markdown è un linguaggio di markup leggero creato da John Gruber. È ampiamente usato per file README, documentazione, blog e appunti. Questo strumento di anteprima renderizza il tuo Markdown in tempo reale senza inviare dati a nessun server.

faqs.a: Markdown is a lightweight markup language for creating formatted text using a plain-text editor. It's widely used for README files, documentation, blogs, and forums.
This tool supports standard Markdown: headings, bold, italic, links, images, code blocks, lists, tables, blockquotes, and more.
Yes. The rendered HTML output can be copied and used directly in your web pages or documentation.

howToUseSteps: Type or paste Markdown in the left editor
See the rendered preview on the right in real-time
Copy the rendered HTML for use in your projects
useCases: Formatting messages for GitHub, Slack, or Discord

jwt-decoder.name: Decodificatore JWT
jwt-decoder.description: Decodifica e ispeziona JSON Web Token (header, payload, firma)
jwt-decoder.pageDescription: Decodifica e ispeziona JSON Web Token. Visualizza header, payload e firma.
jwt-decoder.placeholder: Incolla il tuo token JWT qui (es. eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...)
jwt-decoder.invalidFormat: Formato JWT non valido: previste 3 parti separate da punti
jwt-decoder.seoContent: JWT (JSON Web Token) è un formato di token compatto e sicuro per gli URL, utilizzato per l'autenticazione e lo scambio di informazioni. Un JWT è composto da tre parti: Header (algoritmo e tipo), Payload (claims e dati) e Firma (verifica). I JWT sono comunemente usati in OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect e autenticazione API.

faqs.a: JWT (JSON Web Token) is a compact, URL-safe token format used for authentication and information exchange. It contains a header, payload, and signature.

faqs.q: Is it safe to decode JWTs here?
faqs.a: Yes. Decoding happens entirely in your browser. No tokens are sent to any server. Note: decoding only reads the token — it does not verify the signature.

faqs.q: Can this tool verify JWT signatures?
faqs.a: This tool decodes and displays the token contents. Signature verification requires the secret key, which should not be entered into any online tool.

howToUseSteps: Paste your JWT token in the input field
The header, payload, and signature are decoded automatically
View expiration time and other claims
Copy decoded sections as needed

qrcode-generator.name: Generatore di codici QR
qrcode-generator.description: Genera codici QR da testo, URL o qualsiasi dato
qrcode-generator.pageDescription: Genera codici QR da testo, URL o qualsiasi dato. Scarica come immagine PNG.

Possono essere scansionati da qualsiasi fotocamera di smartphone. Questo strumento genera codici QR con correzione degli errori per una scansione affidabile.

faqs.a: QR (Quick Response) code is a two-dimensional barcode that stores data like URLs, text, or contact info. It can be scanned by smartphones and QR readers.
You can encode any text: URLs, email addresses, phone numbers, WiFi credentials, plain text, and more.

faqs.q: Can I download the QR code?
faqs.a: Yes. Click the Download button to save the QR code as a PNG image that you can use in print or digital materials.

Scan with any smartphone camera to verify

lorem-ipsum.description: Genera testo segnaposto in paragrafi, frasi o parole

Designer e sviluppatori lo usano come testo segnaposto quando il contenuto effettivo non è ancora disponibile. Aiuta a visualizzare i layout senza distrarre i lettori con contenuti significativi.

faqs.a: Lorem Ipsum is standard placeholder text used in publishing and design since the 1500s. It helps designers focus on layout without being distracted by readable content.

Placeholder content for mockups and wireframes

html-entity.name: Codificatore entità HTML
html-entity.description: Codifica e decodifica entità HTML e caratteri speciali
html-entity.pageDescription: Codifica caratteri speciali in entità HTML o decodifica le entità in caratteri.
html-entity.seoContent: Le entità HTML sono codici speciali usati per visualizzare caratteri riservati in HTML. Caratteri come <, >, & e \" devono essere codificati per evitare che vengano interpretati come markup HTML. Questo è fondamentale per prevenire attacchi XSS e visualizzare frammenti di codice.

faqs.a: HTML entities are special codes that represent characters that have meaning in HTML (like <, >, &) or characters not available on a standard keyboard.

faqs.q: When should I encode HTML entities?
faqs.a: Encode when displaying user input in HTML to prevent XSS attacks, or when you need to display special characters like ©, ™, or mathematical symbols.

faqs.q: Does this handle all special characters?
faqs.a: Yes. This tool handles all standard HTML entities including named entities (&), decimal (&), and hexadecimal (&) formats.

howToUseSteps: Enter HTML text or entities in the input field
Click 'Encode' to convert special characters to HTML entities
Click 'Decode' to convert HTML entities back to readable text
Copy the result
useCases: Preventing XSS attacks by escaping user input
Displaying code snippets in HTML pages
Working with special characters in web content

css-minifier.name: Compressore / Formattatore CSS
css-minifier.description: Comprimi o formatta il codice CSS per la produzione o la leggibilità
css-minifier.pageDescription: Comprimi il CSS per la produzione o formattalo per la leggibilità. Rimuove commenti e spazi bianchi superflui.
css-minifier.seoContent: La compressione CSS rimuove caratteri non necessari come spazi bianchi, commenti e punti e virgola per ridurre la dimensione del file. File CSS più piccoli si caricano più velocemente, migliorando le prestazioni del sito web e l'esperienza utente. Usa la modalità di formattazione per rendere nuovamente leggibile il CSS compresso.

faqs.a: CSS minification removes whitespace, comments, and unnecessary characters from CSS code to reduce file size and improve page load speed.

faqs.q: Does minification change my CSS behavior?
faqs.a: No. Minification only removes formatting — it doesn't change how your CSS works. The minified version produces identical visual results.

faqs.q: How much file size can I save?
faqs.a: Typically 20-40% reduction depending on the original formatting. Heavily commented files may see even greater savings.

howToUseSteps: Paste your CSS code in the input field
Click 'Minify' to remove whitespace and comments
Or click 'Beautify' to format compressed CSS for readability
Copy the result for your project

number-base.name: Convertitore di basi numeriche
number-base.description: Converti numeri tra binario, ottale, decimale ed esadecimale
number-base.pageDescription: Converti numeri tra decimale, binario, ottale ed esadecimale all'istante.
number-base.helperText: Digita un numero in qualsiasi campo e le altre basi verranno calcolate automaticamente.
number-base.seoTitle: Informazioni sui sistemi di basi numeriche
number-base.seoContent: Diversi sistemi di basi numeriche sono usati nell'informatica: Binario (base 2) per le operazioni a livello macchina, Ottale (base 8) per i permessi Unix, Decimale (base 10) per l'uso quotidiano, ed Esadecimale (base 16) per indirizzi di memoria, colori e rappresentazione binaria compatta.

faqs.a: Number bases (or radixes) are systems for representing numbers. Common bases: binary (base 2), octal (base 8), decimal (base 10), and hexadecimal (base 16).
Hexadecimal is compact and maps neatly to binary — each hex digit represents exactly 4 binary bits. It's widely used for colors, memory addresses, and byte values.
Binary (base 2) is the fundamental language of computers. Understanding binary helps with bitwise operations, networking (IP addresses), and low-level programming.

howToUseSteps: Enter a number in any base (binary, octal, decimal, or hex)
All other base conversions update automatically
Copy any converted value with the copy button
useCases: Converting between hex and binary for programming
Understanding IP addresses and subnet masks

text-diff.name: Confronto testi
text-diff.description: Confronta due testi ed evidenzia le differenze
text-diff.pageDescription: Confronta due testi fianco a fianco ed evidenzia le differenze tra di essi.
text-diff.seoContent: Il confronto di testi (diff) compara due versioni di un testo ed evidenzia le differenze. È essenziale per la revisione del codice, il confronto di documenti e il tracciamento delle modifiche. Le righe verdi indicano aggiunte, le righe rosse indicano rimozioni.

faqs.a: A text diff compares two texts and highlights the differences — additions, deletions, and unchanged lines. It's similar to how Git shows code changes.
This tool uses a line-by-line comparison algorithm that identifies added, removed, and unchanged lines between the two texts.
Yes. The diff tool works with any text including source code, configuration files, documentation, or plain text.

howToUseSteps: Paste the original text in the left field
Paste the modified text in the right field
Click 'Compare' to see highlighted differences
Green lines are additions, red lines are deletions

word-counter.name: Contaparole
word-counter.description: Conta parole, caratteri, frasi e paragrafi nel testo
word-counter.pageDescription: Conta parole, caratteri, frasi, paragrafi e stima il tempo di lettura.
word-counter.placeholder: Inizia a digitare o incolla il tuo testo qui per vedere il conteggio delle parole, dei caratteri e altro...

Perfetto per scrittori, studenti e creatori di contenuti che devono rispettare requisiti di conteggio parole.

faqs.a: It counts words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, and lines. It also estimates reading time.
Reading time is estimated based on an average reading speed of 200 words per minute, which is the standard for English text.

faqs.q: Does it work with non-English text?
faqs.a: Yes. The character and line counting works with all languages. Word counting is space-based, which works well for most languages.

howToUseSteps: Paste or type your text in the input field
Statistics update in real-time as you type
View word frequency analysis below the text
Check the reading time estimate for your content
useCases: Meeting blog post or essay word count requirements
Checking character limits for social media

password-generator.description: Genera password casuali e sicure con opzioni personalizzabili
password-generator.pageDescription: Genera password forti e casuali con lunghezza e tipi di caratteri personalizzabili.

Strong passwords are at least 12 characters long, use a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols, and avoid dictionary words or personal information.
No. Passwords are generated entirely in your browser and never sent to any server. There is no logging or storage.

cron-parser.name: Parser espressioni Cron
cron-parser.description: Analizza e spiega espressioni cron con i prossimi orari di esecuzione
cron-parser.pageDescription: Analizza espressioni cron in descrizioni leggibili con i prossimi orari di esecuzione programmati.
cron-parser.seoContent: Cron è un pianificatore di attività basato sul tempo nei sistemi Unix-like. Un'espressione cron è composta da 5 campi: minuto, ora, giorno del mese, mese e giorno della settimana. I caratteri speciali includono * (qualsiasi), / (passo), , (elenco) e - (intervallo). Ampiamente utilizzato in CI/CD, attività pianificate e automazione.

faqs.a: A cron expression is a string of 5 fields (minute, hour, day, month, weekday) that defines a schedule for recurring tasks in Unix-like systems.

faqs.q: What do the special characters mean?
faqs.a: * means any value, / means step (*/5 = every 5), , means list (1,3,5), - means range (1-5), and specific numbers mean exact values.

faqs.q: Can I see when my cron job will run next?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your cron expression and the tool will show the next scheduled execution times, plus a human-readable description.

howToUseSteps: Enter a cron expression (5 fields: minute hour day month weekday)
Or click a quick preset button for common schedules
View the human-readable description
Check the next scheduled run times
useCases: Setting up scheduled tasks on Linux servers

json-yaml.name: Convertitore JSON ↔ YAML
json-yaml.description: Converti istantaneamente tra formati JSON e YAML
json-yaml.pageDescription: Converti JSON in YAML e YAML in JSON online. Veloce, gratuito e funziona nel tuo browser.
json-yaml.yamlPlaceholder:
Incolla il tuo YAML qui...

faqs.q: What's the difference between JSON and YAML?
faqs.a: JSON uses braces and brackets with strict syntax. YAML uses indentation and is more human-readable. Both represent the same data structures.

faqs.q: Why convert between JSON and YAML?

chmod-calculator.seoContent: I permessi dei file Linux controllano chi può leggere (r), scrivere (w) ed eseguire (x) file e directory. I permessi sono impostati per tre gruppi: proprietario, gruppo e altri. Il comando chmod usa la notazione numerica (ottale) come 755 o la notazione simbolica come rwxr-xr-x.

faqs.a: chmod (change mode) is a Unix/Linux command that sets file and directory permissions. It controls who can read, write, and execute files.
755 means: owner can read/write/execute (7), group can read/execute (5), others can read/execute (5). It's the standard permission for directories and scripts.

faqs.q: What's the difference between numeric and symbolic notation?
faqs.a: Numeric uses octal digits (755). Symbolic uses letters (rwxr-xr-x). They represent the same permissions — numeric is more compact, symbolic is more readable.

xml-formatter.name: Formatore XML

xml-formatter.seoContent: XML (Extensible Markup Language) is widely used for data exchange, configuration files, and web services like SOAP APIs. Properly formatted XML improves readability and helps identify structural errors quickly. This tool formats, minifies, and validates XML documents in your browser. It supports large XML files, preserves CDATA sections and comments, and highlights syntax for easier inspection. Whether you are debugging API responses or cleaning up configuration files, this formatter handles it all without sending your data to any server.

faqs.q: How do I format XML online?
faqs.a: Paste your XML into the input area and click Format. The tool will indent and structure your XML with proper nesting and line breaks.

faqs.q: Can I minify XML to reduce file size?

faqs.q: Does this tool validate XML syntax?

faqs.q: Can I convert JSON back to CSV?

faqs.q: Does it handle nested JSON objects?

http-status.name: Riferimento codici HTTP
http-status.seoContent: HTTP status codes are three-digit numbers returned by servers to indicate the result of a client request. They are grouped into five classes: 1xx (informational), 2xx (success), 3xx (redirection), 4xx (client errors), and 5xx (server errors). Understanding these codes is essential for API development, debugging network issues, and building robust web applications. This reference tool lets you quickly look up any status code, understand its meaning, and learn when to use it in your own APIs. It covers all standard codes defined in RFC 7231 and common extensions.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 401 and 403?
faqs.a: 401 Unauthorized means the client has not provided valid authentication credentials. 403 Forbidden means the client is authenticated but does not have permission to access the resource.

faqs.q: When should I use 200 vs 201 vs 204?
faqs.a: Use 200 OK for successful GET requests, 201 Created when a new resource is created (POST), and 204 No Content for successful requests with no response body (DELETE).

faqs.q: What does a 502 Bad Gateway error mean?
faqs.a: 502 means the server acting as a gateway received an invalid response from an upstream server. It usually indicates a problem with the backend service, not the client.

howToUseSteps: Browse the status codes by category (1xx through 5xx)
Click on any code to see its detailed description
Use the search box to find a specific code quickly
Review the use cases to understand when to return each code
useCases: Debugging HTTP errors in web applications

mime-types.name: Ricerca tipi MIME
mime-types.pageDescription: Trova tipi MIME per estensione file.
mime-types.seoContent: MIME types (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) define the nature and format of a document or file. Web servers use MIME types in Content-Type headers to tell browsers how to handle files. Getting the MIME type wrong can cause browsers to download files instead of displaying them, or break file uploads. This tool lets you look up the correct MIME type for any file extension, or find which extensions correspond to a given content type. It includes hundreds of MIME types covering images, audio, video, documents, fonts, and application-specific formats.

faqs.a: A MIME type is a string like 'text/html' or 'image/png' that tells the browser or client how to interpret and display a file. It consists of a type and subtype separated by a slash.

faqs.q: How do I find the MIME type for a file extension?
faqs.a: Type the file extension (e.g., .pdf, .webp) into the search box. The tool will show the corresponding MIME type and category.

faqs.q: What MIME type should I use for JSON?
faqs.a: Use 'application/json' for JSON data. For JSON with a specific schema, you can use vendor types like 'application/vnd.api+json'.

howToUseSteps: Enter a file extension (e.g., .svg) or MIME type (e.g., image/svg+xml)
Browse the results showing matching types and extensions
Click on any result to see full details
Copy the MIME type string for use in your code
useCases: Setting correct Content-Type headers in web servers
Building file type detection in applications

escape-unescape.name: Escape / Unescape
escape-unescape.description: Escape o unescape HTML, JavaScript e JSON
escape-unescape.pageDescription: Escape caratteri speciali per HTML, JavaScript o JSON.
escape-unescape.seoContent: Character escaping converts special characters into safe representations to prevent injection attacks and parsing errors. HTML escaping converts characters like < > & into entities (< > &). JavaScript escaping handles quotes and backslashes in strings. JSON escaping ensures strings are valid within JSON documents. This tool supports all three escaping modes and their reverse operations. It is essential for security-conscious developers who need to sanitize user input, build safe HTML output, or debug encoded strings in logs and API responses.

faqs.q: What is the difference between HTML and JavaScript escaping?
faqs.a: HTML escaping converts < > & " to HTML entities for safe display in web pages. JavaScript escaping adds backslashes before quotes, newlines, and special characters for safe use in JS strings.

faqs.q: Why do I need to escape strings?
faqs.a: Unescaped strings can cause XSS (cross-site scripting) attacks in HTML, syntax errors in JavaScript, or invalid JSON. Escaping ensures special characters are treated as data, not code.

faqs.q: Can I unescape encoded strings back to plain text?
faqs.a: Yes. Switch to Unescape mode and paste the encoded string. The tool will convert escape sequences back to their original characters.

howToUseSteps: Select the escaping format: HTML, JavaScript, or JSON
Choose Escape or Unescape mode
Paste your text into the input area
Copy the escaped or unescaped result
useCases: Sanitizing user input before rendering in HTML
Preparing strings for JSON API payloads
Debugging escaped characters in log files

ip-calculator.description: Calcola maschera sottorete, rete e broadcast
ip-calculator.pageDescription: Calcola maschera sottorete, indirizzo di rete e broadcast.
ip-calculator.seoContent: IP subnetting divides a network into smaller subnetworks to improve performance and security. Understanding subnets is critical for network administrators, DevOps engineers, and anyone configuring cloud infrastructure. This calculator takes an IP address with a CIDR prefix (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) and instantly computes the subnet mask, network address, broadcast address, first and last usable host, and total number of hosts. It supports both IPv4 addresses and various CIDR notations from /8 to /30. All calculations are done locally in your browser.

faqs.a: CIDR (Classless Inter-Domain Routing) notation like /24 indicates how many bits are used for the network portion of an IP address. /24 means 24 network bits and 8 host bits, allowing 254 usable hosts.

faqs.q: How do I calculate the number of hosts in a subnet?
faqs.a: The formula is 2^(32-prefix) - 2 for IPv4. The subtraction accounts for the network address and broadcast address. A /24 subnet has 2^8 - 2 = 254 usable hosts.

faqs.q: What is the difference between network and broadcast address?
faqs.a: The network address is the first address in a subnet (all host bits 0) and identifies the subnet. The broadcast address is the last (all host bits 1) and sends packets to all hosts in the subnet.

howToUseSteps: Enter an IP address (e.g., 192.168.1.100)
Enter the CIDR prefix length (e.g., /24) or subnet mask
View the calculated network address, broadcast, and host range
Copy any value you need for your network configuration

Configuring firewall rules with correct subnet ranges
Studying for network certification exams (CCNA, CompTIA)

All data is generated randomly in your browser using established patterns — no real personal information is used. Names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, companies, dates, UUIDs, IP addresses, and more. Each type produces realistic-looking values.

hmac-generator.name: Generatore HMAC
hmac-generator.pageDescription: Genera firme HMAC con SHA-256 o SHA-1.
hmac-generator.seoContent: HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) combines a cryptographic hash function with a secret key to verify both data integrity and authenticity. Unlike simple hashing, HMAC requires the secret key to generate and verify signatures, making it resistant to tampering. HMAC-SHA256 is the most commonly used variant and is required by many APIs and webhook systems (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify). This tool generates HMAC signatures using SHA-1, SHA-256, or SHA-512 algorithms. Enter your message and secret key, and get the signature in hexadecimal or Base64 format. All computation happens locally.

faqs.q: What is the difference between HMAC and a regular hash?
faqs.a: A regular hash (like SHA-256) only takes a message as input. HMAC also requires a secret key, so only parties who know the key can generate or verify the signature. This prevents tampering.

faqs.q: Which HMAC algorithm should I use?
faqs.a: HMAC-SHA256 is the most common and recommended choice. It offers strong security and is required by most modern APIs. Use SHA-1 only for legacy compatibility.

faqs.q: How do I verify a webhook signature with HMAC?
faqs.a: Compute the HMAC of the webhook payload using your secret key, then compare it to the signature in the webhook header. If they match, the webhook is authentic and untampered.

howToUseSteps: Enter or paste the message to sign
Enter the secret key
Select the hash algorithm (SHA-256, SHA-1, or SHA-512)
Copy the generated HMAC signature in hex or Base64
useCases: Verifying webhook signatures from payment providers
Generating message authentication codes for secure communication

url-parser.name: Parser URL
url-parser.pageDescription: Analizza URL in protocollo, host, pathname e parametri.
url-parser.seoContent: URLs (Uniform Resource Locators) contain multiple components: protocol (https), hostname, port, pathname, query parameters, and fragment hash. Understanding URL structure is essential for web development, API design, and debugging network requests. This tool breaks any URL into its individual components for easy inspection. It decodes percent-encoded characters, parses query strings into key-value pairs, and validates URL format. Useful for debugging redirect chains, analyzing tracking parameters, and understanding complex API endpoints.

faqs.q: What are the parts of a URL?
faqs.a: A URL consists of: protocol (https://), hostname (example.com), port (:8080), pathname (/api/users), query string (?id=123&sort=name), and fragment hash (#section).
Query parameters start after the ? character and are separated by &. Each parameter is a key=value pair. Values may be percent-encoded for special characters.
Yes. The tool automatically decodes percent-encoded characters (like %20 for spaces) and displays the decoded values alongside the raw encoded form.

binary-text.name: Convertitore testo ↔ binario
binary-text.description: Converti testo in binario e viceversa
binary-text.pageDescription: Converti testo in binario e binario in testo.
binary-text.seoContent: Binary representation is the foundation of all digital computing. Every character you see on screen is stored as a sequence of 0s and 1s. This tool converts text to its binary representation and back. Each character is converted to its UTF-8 binary encoding, displayed as 8-bit groups. It supports all Unicode characters including emoji and characters from non-Latin scripts. The tool is useful for learning about character encoding, debugging encoding issues, and understanding how computers store text data at the lowest level.

faqs.q: How does text to binary conversion work?
faqs.a: Each character is converted to its Unicode code point, then encoded as binary digits. ASCII characters use 8 bits (1 byte), while other Unicode characters may use 16 or 32 bits.

faqs.q: What encoding does this tool use?
faqs.a: The tool uses UTF-8 encoding by default, which is backward-compatible with ASCII and supports all Unicode characters.

faqs.q: Can I convert binary back to text?
faqs.a: Yes. Switch to Binary → Text mode and paste your binary string (space-separated 8-bit groups). The tool will decode it back to readable text.

howToUseSteps: Select the conversion direction: Text → Binary or Binary → Text

Understanding how computers store and process text

pem-decoder.name: Decodificatore PEM / certificato
pem-decoder.seoContent: PEM (Privacy Enhanced Mail) is the most common format for SSL/TLS certificates, private keys, and certificate chains. PEM files are Base64-encoded with header and footer lines like -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----. This tool decodes PEM-formatted certificates and displays all X.509 fields: subject, issuer, validity dates, serial number, signature algorithm, public key details, and extensions like Subject Alternative Names (SANs). It is essential for DevOps engineers managing SSL certificates, debugging TLS handshake failures, and verifying certificate chains.

faqs.q: What information can I see from a PEM certificate?
faqs.a: You can see the subject (domain name), issuer (CA), validity dates, serial number, signature algorithm, public key type and size, and extensions like SANs and key usage.

faqs.q: Is it safe to paste my certificate here?
faqs.a: Yes. All decoding happens locally in your browser. Your certificate data is never sent to any server. Note: never paste private keys in any online tool.

faqs.q: What is the difference between PEM and DER format?
faqs.a: PEM is Base64-encoded text with header/footer lines, readable in any text editor. DER is the raw binary format. This tool only handles PEM format.

howToUseSteps: Paste your PEM-formatted certificate (including BEGIN/END lines)
View the decoded certificate details instantly
Check the validity dates, subject, and issuer information
Verify Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for your domains
useCases: Verifying SSL certificate details before installation
Debugging TLS handshake and certificate chain issues
Inspecting certificate SANs for multi-domain coverage

bcrypt-generator.name: Generatore hash Bcrypt
bcrypt-generator.description: Genera hash bcrypt con costo configurabile
bcrypt-generator.pageDescription: Genera hash password bcrypt con fattore di costo configurabile.
bcrypt-generator.seoContent: Bcrypt is a password hashing function designed to be slow and computationally expensive, making brute-force attacks impractical. Unlike fast hashes like MD5 or SHA-256, bcrypt incorporates a configurable cost factor that controls how many iterations are performed. Each increase in cost doubles the computation time. Bcrypt also automatically generates and embeds a random salt, preventing rainbow table attacks. This tool generates bcrypt hashes from passwords with your chosen cost factor (typically 10-12 for web applications). It can also verify if a password matches a given bcrypt hash. All processing happens locally.

faqs.q: What cost factor should I use for bcrypt?
faqs.a: A cost of 10-12 is recommended for most web applications, balancing security and performance. Cost 10 takes about 100ms per hash. Each increment doubles the time.

faqs.q: Is bcrypt better than SHA-256 for passwords?
